text:
marina: Quiet window reminder — tomorrow 22:00 PT to 02:00 PT for v3.2 rollout. Starting the handoff doc here. Can oncall + product-ops confirm freeze and pin? checklist: https://redwood.internal/handbook/releases/v3.2-checklist :eyes:

Doug: I can cover 22:00-00:30 PT, tina will take 00:30-02:00. Do we have all hotfix exemptions approved?

kate: All exemption requests are in #release-exemptions, approved: coupon-service patch only. Please publish release notes before pin.

deploy-bot: Heads-up — pin step required before canary. Example command: ```/deploy pin -m v3.2.1 -e prod``` :robot_face:

tina: I'll run the preflight smoke at 18:00 PT and post results here. Quick Q — are we enabling cache-busting for the embeddings route? It was flaky in load tests.

marina: No cache-busting — set EMB_CACHE=false in traffic-shift config. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full rollout if green.

Doug: Rollback criteria: if 99th latency > 800ms or error rate > 0.5% in the first 30m, immediate rollback to v3.1. Rollback command: ```/deploy rollback v3.1 -reason 'latency spike'```

kate: I'll prep release notes and push to #announcements. Draft ETA 20:30 PT. :memo:

deploy-buddy: Deploy window lock will be enforced 30 minutes before the start. Use `/freeze-exempt` to request emergency hotfix approval; requests go to eng-leads + product-ops.

tina: Preflight smoke results: PASS. Core endpoints green. Perf snapshot: 99th = 420ms, error = 0.02%. Uploading logs to the runbook link.

marina: Confirmed — good to proceed. Doug please pin and start canary at 22:05 PT. I'll watch dashboards + traces. Everyone stay in this channel for alerts; escalate to oncall-sre if anything looks off. :thumbsup:
